description: Na₄AlGeSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.83 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.81 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.52 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.06 Å. Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₃GeP trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₃GeP trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Al, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₃AlP trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₃GeP trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃GeP trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ge, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₃GeP trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃AlP trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ge, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramids. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ge, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two ONa₃GeP trigonal bipyramids.
